violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic & oil on counter, 79F.
violations.corrective_action: Garlic & oil will be discarded at 4hrs from time pulled out of refrigeration (4pm). Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Based on discussion with the Certified Food Manager, garlic and oil will be placed on Time As A Public Health Control in the future. Procedures will be emailed. Please follow the procedures.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BEIJING BEEF AT 118F AND BLACK PEPPER BEEF AT 118-130F IN HOT TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE. PIC ADJUSTED HOT TABLE TEMPERATURE TO ENSURE PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPERATURES ARE MAINTAINED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Surfaces of the ice tea dispensers and consumer self service utensils are not being cleaned as required. SODA DISPENSER NOZZLES WITH ACCUMULATION OF DISCOLORED SUBSTANCES..
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF VARIOUS OILS, SAUCES AND SPICES ON CART NEAR WOK LINE AND COUNTER AT END OF WOK LINE WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION
